issue.title: Fix chart export
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open any bar chart in Explore.
2. Click `Download as image`.

Expected behavior: a PNG of the chart is downloaded.
Actual behavior: nothing is downloaded and the console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toDataURL')`.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/src/utils/downloadAsImage.ts`.
Acceptance criteria: the image downloads and a focused unit test covers the null canvas case.
